The '''Ancient Seed''' is an [[Artifacts|Artifact]] that can be found by digging up an [[Artifact Spot]] in [[Cindersap Forest]] or [[The Mountain]] (including the [[Quarry]]), or obtained inside [[Artifact Trove]]s, or [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]] after reaching [[Fishing#Fishing Skill|Fishing level 2]]. It can be dropped from [[Bug]]s, [[Grub]]s, [[Cave Fly|Cave Flies]], [[Mutant Fly|Mutant Flies]], and [[Mutant Grub]]s (0.5% chance). It can also be found by cutting foliage on [[Skull Cavern#Prehistoric Floors|Prehistoric Floors]], in [[The Mines]] when they are in a "Dangerous" state, or in the [[Volcano Dungeon]]. Placing a packet of {{Name|Ancient Seeds|class=inline}} in a [[Deconstructor]] yields an Ancient Seed. This artifact can be [[Crafting|crafted]] into viable [[Ancient Seeds|seeds]] that can be planted to grow [[Ancient Fruit]] during [[Spring]], [[Summer]] and [[Fall]], or during any season in the [[Greenhouse]] or the [[Ginger Island]] farm. ==Donation== The only productive use of the first Ancient Seed artifact found is to donate it to the [[Museum]]. The item contributes to the total count of Museum donations. [[Gunther]] will reward the player with one pack of plantable Ancient Seeds and the recipe to craft any further Ancient Seed artifacts into more seeds. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |like=Dwarf,Penny |dislike=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Willy,Krobus,Leo }} ==Bundles== Ancient Seed is not used in any [[bundles]]. ==Recipes== {|class="wikitable" !Image !Name !Description !Ingredients !Recipe From |- |[[File:Ancient Seeds.png]] |[[Ancient Seeds]] |Could these still grow? |{{Name|Ancient Seed|1}} |Donating [[Ancient Seed]] to the [[Museum]] |} ==Tailoring== Ancient Seed is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[File:Shirt237.png|24px]] [[Tailoring|Brown Suit]]. ==Quests== Ancient Seed is not used in any [[quests]]. ==References== See StardewValley.TerrainFeatures.CosmeticPlant::performtoolaction in the game code. ==History== {{History|1.0|Introduced.}} {{History|1.4|Updated sprite, added [[Artifact Trove]] as a source.
